message.content:
Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles typically takes around **six to seven hours** under normal conditions—about 380‑400 miles via I‑80 W into I‑580 E then I‑5 S.  

A few things can push or pull you off that average:

| Factor | Effect |
|--------|--------|
| Heavy weekday morning/afternoon rush near the Bay Area or along I‑5 | +30 min – 1 hr |
| Construction / detours on I‑5 | +15–45 min |
| Weather (fog, rain, snow) | +10–20 min |
| Route changes (I‑680 vs. CA‑84 over the hills) | ±10 min |

If you’re traveling during peak holiday periods or late at night when traffic eases up, you might shave an hour or so off. Conversely, if you hit a major incident or severe weather, add another half‑hour or more. Always check real‑time traffic updates before you leave!
